payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the simplifications made to the architecture of the SEPT model, which resulted in maintaining performance levels similar to previous models.

claims.text: The architecture was simplified by removing the pruner and using a simple pooling layer for span extraction instead of more complex attention mechanisms or LSTM networks.
The model was modified by under-sampling to balance positive and negative samples, which also contributed to the simplification of the architecture.
Despite these simplifications, the SEPT model achieved the same performance as previous models, demonstrating its effectiveness.
